title: Go to Declaration
summary: Jumps the editor caret to the declaration of the symbol represented by a Structure-tree node
intro: Read this when you are in the Structure form and want the editor to jump to where a node's symbol is declared. Right-click the node and choose Go to Declaration; it is an editor jump with no command line equivalent.

surfaces.caption: Go to Declaration
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Choose Go to Declaration; the editor caret lands on the declaration

questions.ask: How do I jump to where a Structure-tree symbol is declared?
questions.command: Structure form > right-click > Go to Declaration
